texts.preamble: K Hashim vs Kunjamma George ( Food Inspector), ... on 26 March, 2026 2026:Ker:26770 Crl.R.P.No.633/2007 1 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr. Justice G.Girish Thursday, The 26Th Day Of March 2026 / 5Th Chaithra, 1948 Crl.Rev.Pet No. 633 Of 2007 Against The Order/Judgment Dated 23.01.2007 In Cmp No.426 Of 2007 Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class -I, Kannur Revision Petitioner/Accused: K Hashim Hashim Trading Co., Cw 932,, Hajee Road, Kannur. By Adv Sri.T.M.Abdul Latheef Respondents/Respondent/State: 1 Kunjamma George ( Food Inspector), Kannur Muncipality Kannur Municipality. 2 State Of Kerala Represented By The Public Prosecutor, High Court Of Kerala,, Ernakulam. By Adv Public Prosecutor Sri.Sudheer G.
texts.facts: Notice was already issued to the petitioner intimating the adjournment of the case, and also informing him that the case would be decided in his absence, if there is no representation on the adjourned posting date. Still, the petitioner did not opt to appear before this Court, or make necessary arrangements for advancing arguments. 2. The order under challenge in this revision petition is one passed by the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Kannur, on 23.01.2007, dismissing the petition filed by the petitioner under Section 20A of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,1954. In the aforesaid case, which was numbered as STC No.808/2004, the petitioner was facing criminal prosecution for the commission of offence under Sections 16(1)(a)(i) of the aforesaid Act. He filed C.M.P.No.426/2007 stating that the Commission Agent, who supplied the misbranded food items, should also be impleaded as an accused in that case. 3. The application was opposed by the prosecution contending that the document relied on by the petitioner in support of the above 2026:KER:26770 3 plea, was only a delivery note, which is not sufficient for invoking the powers under Section 20A of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,1954, for impleadment of the persons referred thereunder. The learned Magistrate accepted the aforesaid contention of the prosecution, and dismissed the petition filed by the petitioner.
